```sql
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),

-- 1. POS Revenue
pos_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        s.region_code,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.currency = 'AUD' THEN t.line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE t.line_total
            END
        ) AS revenue
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON t.txn_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE t.txn_date >= '2025-06-01' AND t.txn_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND t.is_valid = true
    GROUP BY s.region_code
),

-- 2. Ecom Revenue (Excludes cancelled web orders, net of refunds if handled via line totals/status, 
-- stg_ecom__orders has order_status. Let's check non-cancelled orders).
ecom_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region_code,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE l.line_total
            END
        ) AS revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON o.order_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-06-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND LOWER(o.order_status) != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.region_code
),

-- 3. ERP (Wholesale) Revenue
erp_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region_code,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN l.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE l.net_value
            END
        ) AS revenue
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON l.order_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE l.order_date >= '2025-06-01' AND l.order_date <= '2025-06-30'
    GROUP BY c.region_code
),

combined AS (
    SELECT region_code, revenue FROM pos_rev
    UNION ALL
    SELECT region_code, revenue FROM ecom_rev
    UNION ALL
    SELECT region_code, revenue FROM erp_rev
),

region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region_code,
        r.region_name,
        SUM(c.revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM combined c
    JOIN reference.regions r ON c.region_code = r.region_code
    GROUP BY c.region_code, r.region_name
)

SELECT region_name AS answer
FROM region_totals
ORDER BY total_revenue ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
